The '''Village Drums Boutique''' was a shop located at the [[Endor Splendor Inn]] on the forest moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. The shop was advertised at the [[Tomorrowland Starport]].<ref name="ST" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Endor Splendor Inn and its amenities were advertised on a video screen exclusively seen in the queue of the [[Tokyo Disneyland]] version of the original [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] attraction.<ref name="YouTube ST queue">{{YouTube|video=bTHFWK8G_7A|text=TDL : Star Tours Queue Line No. 1|channel=@couperin9|name=couperin9}}</ref>
